purpose: External benchmark acquisition registry. Dataset files remain local and are never committed.

datasets.acquisition: Run npm run benchmark:pii. The importer reads the Apache-2.0 test split and writes a local-only fixture.
After licence review, manually download the official validation-image and face-annotation archives, then run the local manifest importer.
After confirming research/educational use, run npm run benchmark:groundcua. It downloads a deterministic, balanced 300-screenshot local fixture with its labelled UI targets.

Run npm run benchmark:osworld to prepare 40 pinned Chrome workflow specifications. Executing them requires the official OSWorld isolated desktop environment and must not run against personal accounts.
Create and annotate 50-100 captures from test accounts only, then run npm run benchmark:real-web. The validator writes an aggregate-only report and rejects non-test-only provenance.
